input.comment: [Playbook] We have changed the governing law from Delaware to New York so that it aligns with the exclusive New York venue already agreed in the same sentence; our playbook position is New York law with the state and federal courts in New York County. Please also note that the mandatory AAA arbitration in Section 8 is inconsistent with this exclusive court jurisdiction, and we would ask that Section 8 be conformed so disputes proceed in the New York courts.
input.summary: Change governing law from Delaware to New York to match the agreed New York exclusive venue.
